channel_poisson.reading: one draw per tree per step would put tree i on the residue class {i, M+i, ...}; River's poisson is a rejection loop consuming k+1 uniforms for weight k, so the cost is random and the residue class does not hold

consequence: the Jensen path falls under D1 as committed; the Boole bound of T3.2 carries alone, and the Jensen bound is stated only with its hypothesis named, entering no published numeral (D2, D5(b))
criterion_scope: D1 is a criterion on POSITIONS. A displacement proves that the consumed positions are state-dependent; it does not by itself prove that the per-tree draw BLOCKS are probabilistically dependent, because a sequential allocation by adapted stopping times preserves independence on an idealised i.i.d. source. The criterion is sufficient for factorisation and not necessary. The gap is recorded here and argued in docs/theory/S3_dependence_bounds.md; the rule is applied as committed and is not moved after the measurement.

perturbation.operation: tree j replaced by a fresh base model (the in-model drift replacement)

vote_feedback_into_per_tree_learning.reading: ARFClassifier._drift_detector_input is int(not y_true == y_pred) on the PER-TREE prediction passed by learn_one; the ensemble vote does not enter per-tree learning, so the trees are coupled through the generator or not at all
